topic: Which government small savings scheme pays the most, Oct-Dec 2026
caption:
The government's small savings rates for October–December 2026 are out, and they are unchanged.

Top of the table: Sukanya Samriddhi and the Senior Citizens Savings Scheme at 8.2%. Then NSC at 7.7%, Kisan Vikas Patra and the 5-year post office time deposit at 7.5%, the Monthly Income Scheme at 7.4%, and PPF at 7.1%. PPF has now paid 7.1% for 26 straight quarters, since it was cut from 7.9% in April 2020.

But the top rate isn't open to everyone. Sukanya Samriddhi can only be opened for a girl child below 10. The Senior Citizens scheme is only for seniors. PPF runs for 15 years. Eligibility and lock-in decide what fits before the rate does.

Save this as your rate card for the quarter. Send it to a parent or grandparent who asks about these. Follow for one money fix a day.

Sources: small savings rate announcement for Oct–Dec 2026 as reported (30 Sep 2026); scheme eligibility guides.
For education only. Not investment advice.
